application_context.summary:
Application domain: Veterinary clinic.
Backend variant: A: Owners, animals, and relationship deletion.
This is a local FastAPI application that manages persistent domain resources through REST endpoints.
Apply the shared authorization, validation, controlled-error, and transaction conventions specified for the endpoint.

domain_invariants.requirement: Owner, animal, and ownership ids are immutable positive integers; a non-positive path or referenced id is treated as not found. All persisted dates use ISO-8601 calendar dates in the inclusive range 1900-01-01 through 2100-12-31.

An owner has full_name after trimming of 3..120 characters, normalized lowercase email of 5..254 characters matching a conventional local@domain form, and optional phone of 7..25 characters containing only digits, spaces, plus signs, hyphens, and parentheses. A non-deleted owner email is unique.

An animal has name after trimming of 1..80 characters, species in DOG, CAT, RABBIT, BIRD, OTHER, sex in MALE, FEMALE, UNKNOWN, and optional birth_date within REQ-3-001. An optional microchip is exactly 15 decimal digits and is unique among non-deleted animals.

An ownership relation references one non-deleted owner and one non-deleted animal, has started_on within REQ-3-001, status ACTIVE or ENDED, and optional ended_on. Each animal has at most one ACTIVE ownership relation.
An ACTIVE ownership has no ended_on. Ending an ownership sets status ENDED and an ended_on not earlier than started_on; ended ownership history is immutable and remains queryable to admins.

Creating an animal with initial_owner_id atomically creates its ACTIVE ownership. Creating another ACTIVE ownership for an owned animal is rejected; an animal may be reassigned only after the prior relation has been ended.

Deleting an owner is a soft deletion that redacts its email and phone and makes it inaccessible. It is prohibited while the owner has an ACTIVE ownership; ENDED ownership records remain as historical tombstone references and animals are never deleted by owner deletion.

Deleting an animal is a soft deletion. In the same transaction any ACTIVE ownership is ended using the supplied ended_on; all already ENDED ownership records are retained. A deleted animal cannot receive, regain, or be listed as an active ownership subject.

A user may access only the owner profile mapped to the caller account and animals currently owned through that profile; an admin may access every non-deleted resource and ownership history. All other private-route access is denied by default.

Every list is ordered by immutable ascending numeric id and accepts limit 1..100 with default 20 and optional after_id greater than zero. It returns items and next_after_id, which is null when no later matching row exists; filters are applied before the cursor, so pages are stable when earlier rows change.

seed_and_operational_context: The only roles are user and admin. Every endpoint except GET /health requires a valid, non-expired server-side Bearer session and denies unauthenticated requests by default.
Seed accounts include two distinct user accounts and one admin account so ownership authorization can be evaluated without any external identity service.
All JSON write endpoints accept application/json only; malformed JSON is 400, an unsupported media type is 415, and syntactically valid bodies that violate declared fields are 422.
All reads are local and deterministic. Persistence unavailability is 503 and an unexpected local failure is 500; neither failure changes persistent state.
